Post Name Eligibility Criteria
Nursing Superintendent
  • Certificate as Registered Nurse and Midwife having passed 3 years course in General Nursing and Midwifery from a school of Nursing or other institution recognized by the Indian Nursing Council OR B.Sc Nursing. Note The Indian Nursing Council has also laid down certain special concessions for the above courses in respect of Auxiliary Nurse Midwives, Midwives and B grade Nurses, by way of reduced course period etc. Candidates obtaining the qualification prescribed above under these concessions will also be eligible for recruitment.
  • Age Limit : 20-40 Years
Pharmacist (Entry Grade)
  • Bachelor Degree in Pharmacy (Allopathic) from a Central or State Government recognized University or Institute and registered as Pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948 OR Doctor of Pharmacy from a Central or State Government recognized University or Institute and registered as Pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948
  • Age Limit : 20-35 Years
Radiographer (X-Ray Technician)
  • Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics and Chemistry and possess a 2-year Diploma in Radiography, X-Ray Technician, or Radiodiagnosis Technology from a recognized institute. Science graduates with the above 2-year Diploma will be preferred. Equivalent/acceptable qualifications include B.Sc. Medical Technology in Radiography, B.Sc. Medical Radiography and Imaging Technology, B.Sc. (Radiography), B.Sc. Medical Imaging Technology, B.Sc. Radiological & Image Techniques, 2-year Diploma in Radiation Technology, or 10+2 with Physics and Chemistry along with a Bachelor’s degree in Radiation Technology.
  • Age Limit : 19-33 Years
Health & Malaria Inspector Grade-II
  • Candidates must have a B.Sc. degree with Chemistry as a main or optional subject and must possess either a 1-year Diploma in Health/Sanitary Inspector or a 1-year National Trade Certificate (NTC) in Health Sanitary Inspector awarded by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT), Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India.
  • Age Limit : 18-33 Years
AUDIOLOGIST & SPEECH THERAPIST
  • Bachelor in Audiology, Speech Language Pathology (BASLP) from a recognized University and must be registered with Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI).
  • Age Limit : 21-30 Years
Lab Assistant Grade-II
  • Candidates must have passed 12th (10+2) in Science and possess either a Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT) or a Certificate Course in Medical Laboratory Technology equivalent to DMLT. The course must be from a recognized institution, of at least 1 year duration, completed on a full-time basis, with a prescribed examination successfully passed. B.Sc. in Medical Lab Technology after 10+2 Science is also an equivalent/acceptable qualification. Approved qualifications obtained through recognized Open and Distance Learning (ODL) institutions are also acceptable.
  • Age Limit : 18-33 Years
Dialysis Technician
  • B.Sc. plus (a) Diploma in Haemodialysis (or) (b) two years satisfactory in-house Training / Experience in Haemodialysis work in a reputed institution (proof to be attached).
  • NOTE: B.Sc. in Dialysis Techniques/ B.Sc. in Dialysis Technology/ B.Sc. in Renal Dialysis Technology are also equivalent/acceptable qualifications.
  • Age Limit : 20-33 Years
OPTOMETRIST
  • B. Sc. In Optometry or Diploma in Ophthalmic Technician (the course should be of 3 to 4 years duration). The candidate should have Registration with the concerned Council/ Licensing body.
  • Age Limit : 18-33 Years
ECG Technician
  • Candidates must have passed 10+2 or Graduation in Science and possess a Certificate, Diploma, or Degree in ECG Laboratory Technology, Cardiology, Cardiology Technician, or Cardiology Techniques from a reputed institution. The Certificate must be of at least 1 year duration. Qualifications obtained through approved Open and Distance Learning (ODL) mode from UGC-recognized institutions are also acceptable for Central Government employment.
  • Age Limit : 18-33 Years
